title: Affine forward assembly of condensed local perfect scalar models
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $R=\Gamma(*,\Lambda)$ and let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] with finitely many irreducible components. In the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], suppose $K$ is dualizable for derived tensor, meaning a dual with evaluation and coevaluation satisfying both triangle identities. Then there is a pro-etale covering $\{U_i\to X\}$ and for each $i$ a perfect $P_i\in D(R)$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] with $K|_{U_i}\simeq L_{U_i}(P_i)$, where $L$ is the canonical constant-section scalar realization [def-zl-condensed-scalar-realization]. No regularity or flatness of the coefficient ring is assumed, and the $P_i$ may vary. The empty scheme uses an empty covering.

proof.text: Identify the affine scheme with Spec A. Minimal prime ideals index its irreducible components. Finiteness transfers along the affine homeomorphism and minimalPrimes.equivIrreducibleComponents. Every prime contains a minimal prime, so these quotient spectra cover. The quotients are domains; this includes an empty spectrum by an empty indexing set.

For each quotient A/I choose the faithfully flat ind-etale w-contractible algebra Cbar from exists_isWContractibleRing. Pull K back to Spec(A/I), preserving dualizability. Take the algebraic closure of the residue field at the generic point. Apply condensed_irreducible_generic_scalar_model to obtain P and its scalar-model isomorphism on Spec Cbar. Transport the section-ring ind-etale and faithfully flat predicates through ΓSpecIso; ULift transport gives the across-universe form required by the generic theorem.

The retained A-algebra map from ClosedLift to Cbar makes closedModelFiberMap followed by closedModelLiftMap equal the structure map Spec Cbar to Spec A. The canonical derived composition comparison transports the given model isomorphism to exactly the input of condensed_finite_closed_model_lifts. That theorem supplies the pro-etale cover and the individual scalar models on its members.

Push the cover forward through the canonical affine isomorphism Spec Γ(X,top) to X. Its singleton is a pro-etale cover, so composition preserves covering. The same derived composition comparison transports each scalar model. No component has been required to share its scalar complex with another.

lean.statement:
theorem condensed_affine_dualizable_local_perfect
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    (hcomponents : (irreducibleComponents X).Finite)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)))
    (hK : Nonempty (HasRightDual K)) :
    ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : C.I₀,
      ∃ P : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (condensedScalarRing Λ)),
        DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex P ∧
        Nonempty (((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ (C.f i)).mapDerivedCategory).obj K ≅
          (condensedScalarRealization Λ (C.X i)).obj P)
